descriptionHtml:
Decision D8 · P2 · Daniela

Should In Today reset at server midnight; the worst-case AI wait is ~38 s (UAT says ~30 s); should empty transcript rows ('0 lines') be hidden

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-14/S21, TC-16/S16

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S13 Server day change: the per-day rule switches at the server's midnight

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Attendance state persists correctly per day, by server time. On the same day a mark survives a reload, navigation and other devices. The day boundary follows the server clock, not the device clock. (TFA-92587 AC 6; UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Two residents marked In Today at 23:30 on server day D, one left un-marked

When Open Today's Visits at 23:59 on D and at 00:01 on D+1 (server time)

Then The per-day rule (Q3: marks cleared at the server day change, or carried over) is applied at the server's midnight. The wrong-device-clock half of 3.8 is S16

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92587 AC 6 + UAT 3.8. Until Q3 is answered only 'switched by server time, at the server's midnight' is judged. Main stores a plain boolean and never clears it

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela; the Allure status was changed by the triage from unknown to failed.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa

Residents marked In Today at 23:30 are still on Today's Visits after the server's midnight. Nobody has decided whether marks should clear each day or carry over.

Evidence: allure 6fbcbc44, record-only: the marks carried over (A and B still In Today). TC-09 Q3 decides clear-at-midnight vs carry-over (draft #6(b), never posted). The exact 23:59/00:01 cell was not run because there is no server-clock control. Main stores a plain inTodaysSession boolean with no day. TFA-92587 AC 6 says 'persists correctly per day (server time)'.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S13

Server day change: the per-day rule switches at the server's midnight

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

New local lane manual: status record-only in manual/results.json → needs a person (record only, no cell was judged → a person looks).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): api spec. Mark two residents In Today with their stamps at 23:30 of the previous server day (UTC) and leave one unmarked; run snf:applyLifecycle with today's day, read In Today / snf:listCounts. Record whether the marks switched at the server day change. — Q3 (cleared at the day change or carried over) is open, so the outcome is recorded, not judged. The exact 23:59 vs 00:01 instants need a movable server clock; back-dated stamps reproduce 'marked yesterday, read today', which is the half that decides the rule.

Detail:

0/0 judged cells pass, 1 recorded, 1 NOT RUN. Not run: 23:59 on D vs 00:01 on D+1 at the exact instants (needs the server clock moved across midnight (server-clock, not built); the back-dated marks reproduce 'marked yesterday, read today'). Recorded: marks set at 23:30 on the previous server day, read after the server's midnight (Q3: cleared or carried over) = {"A":true,"B":true,"C":false,"todaysVisits":["QA Resident S13 marked A","QA Resident S13 marked B"],"counts":{"done":0,"ready":true,"today":.

Manual checklist (manualChecklist):

  • [TC-09/S13 the moment of server midnight (5 minutes; the local stack's server day is UTC, UTC 00:00 = 9:00 Tokyo)]
  • 1. Around 8:50 Tokyo: in Nursing Home, mark two QA residents In Today; leave the third unmarked.
  • 2. 8:58: look at the Today's Visits and Dashboard numbers; take a screenshot.
  • 3. 9:02: refresh, look at Today's Visits and Dashboard again; take a screenshot.
  • 4. Note whether the two marks were cleared or kept (Q3 is not decided yet, so record only, no Pass/Fail). Automation already confirmed: on main, In Today is a boolean with no date and is kept across any midnight.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Moving the server day needs the aging helper and a server-clock control, both through the local stack's admin key; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so this stays on the local stack (when the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
